title: deployment-proposal.v1
description: The immutable record of a deployment PLAN prepared by a run: what would be done, to what, at which exact revision, under which engine, with which prerequisite checks performed and which not. Evidence of planning; never an approval, never a claim that anything happened. The engine-owned sections (revision, manifest, engine, observed, operations, checks, health, rollback, engineCommands) are carried exactly as the deployment engine wrote them. proposalDigest is over the canonical document with proposalDigest cleared; an approval binds to it, and a future execution boundary recomputes it and re-checks the current state before acting.

supersedesPackageId.description: Present when the package that produced this proposal replaced an earlier one; the earlier proposal stays on its own receipt and is never rewritten.

question.description: When blocked: the one thing that must be answered or resolved before a plan can be made.

revision.description: The exact commit the deployment would land, and how it was resolved. A branch name or HEAD is never the only reference.

manifest.description: The service manifest's digest at observation time.

engine.description: The deployment engine's identity and revision.

operations.description: In execution order; each flags whether it mutates and whether a rollback would not undo it.

unperformed.description: Prerequisite checks the plan did NOT run. Planning never implies these passed.

rollback.description: What the engine can put back, and what it cannot (migrations and other irreversible effects).

engineCommands.description: Every command the engine ran to plan, for a reader to confirm they were reads.
